Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the content of the Theudebert I Wikipedia page. The visible text clearly stated: "He was the son of Theuderic I". However, the Planner's analysis falsely claimed that the page confirmed Theudebert I was the son of "Clovis I". This hallucination led the Planner to conclude that Clovis I was Wisigard's father-in-law instead of the correct answer, Theuderic I (Theuderic I). The WebSurfer correctly retrieved the text, but the Planner made the factual error in interpreting it.
